cases.input: The optimized import passes functional tests and drops median runtime from 38.2s to 8.7s with query count from 50,214 to 17 under the same workload.
requiredBehaviors: verify workload comparability before accepting the delta
report functional and performance evidence separately
classify success and propose a stable regression guard
forbiddenBehaviors: accept performance improvement when functional tests fail

cases.input: Runtime improves 35%, but peak memory doubles and the target did not define an acceptable memory trade-off.
requiredBehaviors: surface the memory regression as a trade-off
avoid unconditional PASS when acceptance is unresolved
forbiddenBehaviors: hide memory cost because latency improved

cases.input: The candidate feels faster in manual use but the benchmark workload changed and only one timing was recorded.
requiredBehaviors: require comparable workload and measurement method
improve the measurement design before closure
forbiddenBehaviors: create a hard CI threshold from unstable evidence
